name: Cali Blaze Infused Preroll | Blue Muffin
description:
Blueberry meets baked goods. The hybrid genetics bring heavy body relaxation while the muffin-top sweetness keeps it from being one-note. Smells like a bakery that grows its own weed. Slow burn, clean finish.
Key terpenes: Myrcene, Pinene, Caryophyllene

A Cali-Blaze classic. The go-to smoke for infused preroll lovers. This 1.2g joint is injected with 400mg of liquid diamond x live resin concentrate and kissed with one of 24 signature flavors. A smoking experience that delivers on potency and taste.

Infused with Liquid Diamonds: THC-A diamonds liquified for a clean, high-potency infusion. Clean, clear-headed potency — no muddled high.
